The Administration Building requires replacement of its 2,000-square-foot metal roof with a new asphalt shingle system that includes underlayment, drip-edge flashing, rotten fascia and sheathing repairs, and full gutter and downspout replacement. The existing metal system is not suited for the damp coastal environment and has resulted in deteriorated underlayment and recurring water intrusion at the ridges. Both projects will eliminate ongoing patch repairs, resolve code-compliance issues, and protect critical infrastructure housed within each facility. Work will be coordinated with the park’s project manager but performed primarily by the roofing contractor. Work Included Work under this contract includes complete removal and disposal of all existing roofing materials down to the roof deck for both buildings. The contractor will install new code-approved underlayment, full perimeter drip-edge flashing, and high-quality asphalt roofing systems with all required trim, fasteners, tie-downs, and manufacturer-specified components.
